hidden_stack_findings: Oasis Garden (D19 freehold, 134 units): 62 three-BR units at 1,216-1,647 sqft, 6-mo avg ~$1,673 psf. The entry 3BR stack (1,216 sqft) prices at ~$2.03M — inside band, over 1,000 sqft, freehold, resale. This is the single best 'hidden qualifying 3BR in a large development' this week.
Bliss @ Kovan (D19 freehold): 3BR footprints run 1,163-2,357 sqft but current in-size listings all price above band ($2.8M+). Large development, but no hidden in-band stack right now.
Kovan Residences / Kovan Regency (D19): genuine large 3BR stacks (up to 1,442 / 1,130 sqft) at low psf, but leasehold -> excluded by tenure.

psf_cap_vs_market_gap.read: D15 freehold (Carpmael ~$1,874, Straits ~$2,000-2,128 psf) trades AT or ABOVE the effective cap once you demand 1,000+ sqft, so D15 only clears in boutique resale at the smaller end. D19 freehold (Oasis Garden ~$1,673, Fiorenza ~$1,504) sits well UNDER the cap, so the budget stretches to genuine 3BR size only in D19. The gap between the ~$1,809 effective cap (at 1,216 sqft) and D19 freehold's ~$1,673 is the ~$135 psf (~8%) of negotiating/appreciation headroom; in D15 that gap is negative.

filter_tradeoff_insight: The freehold + $2.0-2.2M + >=1,000 sqft + resale intersection is now concentrated in exactly two shapes: (1) large older D19 freehold projects where a 3BR stack happens to land in-band (Oasis Garden), and (2) boutique D15 freehold resale at the smaller 3BR end (Carpmael Thirty-Eight). Everything else in the tracking list fails on a single, predictable axis: the three Kovan leasehold projects (Kovan Regency/Residences, Midtown) fail TENURE while offering the best size-for-quantum; the 999-yr/new-launch stock (Jansen House, Straits, Kovan Jewel) fails only the NEW-LAUNCH rule while clearing tenure+size. The live trade-off is therefore no longer 'PSF vs region' but 'which single filter to relax': relax tenure -> Kovan leasehold opens ~1,055-1,442 sqft 3BR from $1.58M; relax new-launch -> Jansen House 999-yr 1,012 sqft at ~$2.04M opens; keep both hard -> the pool is essentially Oasis Garden + Carpmael Thirty-Eight.
